thread:
rachel: Heads-up team  quick copy sprint for the landing cards + webinar routing. Need: 2 hero variants per mode, one-line subhead, 1 short CTA, a social-safe benchmark tease (no numbers), and HubSpot routing rules. Handoff tomorrow AM.

omar: Got it. Tone map: Hosted = builder-first, punchy. Dedicated = pragmatic (SLOs/cost). Private = compliance + trust. CTA length: 1-3 words.

bea: Draft A/B (very compact)
- Hosted A: \"Hosted API for builders\"  \"Start building fast, scale with confidence.\"  CTA: \"Try Hosted\"
- Hosted B: \"Start on Hosted\"  \"Free credits for rapid prototyping.\"  CTA: \"Start free\"

- Dedicated A: \"Reserved GPU capacity\"  \"Stable throughput for production loads.\"  CTA: \"Reserve\"
- Dedicated B: \"Dedicated for production\"  \"SLA-backed performance, lower unit costs.\"  CTA: \"Get capacity\"

- Private A: \"Private deployments\"  \"VPC, KMS, on-prem options for regulated apps.\"  CTA: \"Request demo\"
- Private B: \"Redwood in your network\"  \"Keep data in your control with enterprise-grade security.\"  CTA: \"Contact sales\"

nate: Love these. Social-safe benchmark teaser (short): \"Join our webinar for an independent demo and benchmark walkthrough across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments.\" Short alt for X: \"Benchmarks + demo  5/14  Register.\"

rachel: Good. Bea  mark primary variant per mode. Nate  drop the HubSpot routing snippet and utm plan.

nate: HubSpot routing pseudo (ops can convert):
```
# form field: deployment_interest -> hosted | dedicated | private
if deployment_interest == \"hosted\":
  set lifecycle_stage = \"MQL\"
  owner = \"marketing\"
  add_hidden_field(utm_campaign=\"launch_webinar\", utm_source=\"social\")
elif deployment_interest == \"dedicated\":
  set owner = \"AE_pool\"
  tag = \"dedicated_lead\"
  notify = \"ae-team@redwood.com\"
elif deployment_interest == \"private\":
  set owner = \"Enterprise_SDR\"
  priority = \"high\"
  notify = \"sales-enterprise@redwood.com\"
```
Also recommend form names: `hosted_trial_form`, `dedicated_interest_form`, `private_contact_form`.

bea: Microcopy for registration page (single line): \"Register for a 60-min session: 30m demo, 15m benchmark walkthrough, 15m live Q&A. Select your deployment interest to route your request.\"

omar: Confirmation email microcopy: \"Thanks — calendar invite sent. Want Dedicated/Private follow-up? Reply and we'll connect you to an AE.\"

formbot: Calendar: Webinar \"Deployment modes: demo + benchmarks\" scheduled 2025-05-14 15:00 UTC. Speakers: @rachel @bea @nate :calendar:

rachel: Perfect. Bea  flag the final primary variant for design. Nate  convert snippet to HubSpot workflow JSON and post the workflow IDs once pushed. I'll assemble the launch doc and hand off to design + ops. Thanks team :rocket:
